description: This Java class defines a Liquibase custom change for inserting core concept map types into the database, supporting batch insert operations with configurable visible and hidden concept map types.

classes.name: AddConceptMapTypesChangeset
classes.description: A class implementing a custom Liquibase task to batch insert concept map types into the database, with support for configurable visible and hidden types.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the custom change by running batch insert with the given database connection.

methods.name: runBatchInsert
methods.description: Performs batch insert of concept map types into the database, handling transactions and exceptions.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Executes a SQL query to retrieve an integer value, used for fetching user ID.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the arrays of concept map types from comma-separated strings.

methods.name: setVisibleConceptMapTypes
methods.description: Setter for visible concept map types string parameter.

methods.name: setHiddenConceptMapTypes
methods.description: Setter for hidden concept map types string parameter.

methods.name: getConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Returns a confirmation message after completing the change.

methods.name: setFileOpener
methods.description: Setter for resource accessor, not used in this implementation.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation of the database before executing the change, currently returns null indicating no errors.
